settings.name: Name
settings.p8: Private key (.p8) – paste the full contents
settings.fill_required: Fill in Issuer ID, Key ID and the .p8 key.
settings.g1l:
• Open App Store Connect → Users and Access → Integrations.
  • Choose App Store Connect API → Team Keys and tap +.
  • Give it a name (e.g. “Homey”) and the role Admin (or App Manager + Sales).
  • Tap Generate.
settings.g2l:
• The Issuer ID is shown above the list of keys. Copy it.
  • The Key ID is in the list and in the file name AuthKey_KEYID.p8.
settings.g3l:
• Tap “Download API Key” – Apple allows this only once.
  • Open the .p8 file in a text editor and paste the full contents above, including the BEGIN/END lines.
  • The key is stored only on your Homey.
settings.g4l:
• App Store Connect → Business: the 8-digit number next to your address.
  • Needed for downloads, updates and proceeds (Sales Reports). Apple publishes the figures of yesterday once a day.
